headline: Peak opens on target; night vert debt finally paid
narrative: Peak phase opened with the biggest vert ask of the plan, and it landed — a whisker over target, with time on feet just shy of its ask. The night work owed since W36 got paid off in style: a seven-rep Sierra Helada session started in the small hours when Altea's fireworks killed any chance of sleep, with headlamp time and the first proper pole practice banked. Thursday's six hill reps and Friday's Sierra Helada time trial plus a top-up rep closed out the elevation. Honest caveat: the focus asked for a long night back-to-back, and this was one huge night day rather than two stacked ones.

No flags at all — no calf noise, the ankle from W38 has gone quiet, and a new round of rehab exercises is in before the hard sessions. Cumulatively the push toward Costa Blanca stays on schedule. Next week is peak time on feet and the full dress rehearsal: kit, nutrition, night — treat it as the race in miniature.
